long_description:
Pull up in your brightest, boldest, & tackiest holiday knits on Friday, Decr 4th, as we transform Club 624 into a high-octane neon festival!

About this Event

Philly, prepare for the ultimate culture clash. 
On Friday, December 4th, we are taking over Club 624 and turning it into a high-octane, neon-drenched winter festival.

This isn't your average office holiday gathering—we are stripping away the traditional holiday aesthetic and replacing it with the raw, driving energy of an underground warehouse rave, fully fueled by the heaviest Desi music in the scene.

Behind the decks, the unstoppable DJ Dharak is taking complete control of the night. Known for devastating dance floors with flawless mixing, 
Dharak will be steering a high-speed sonic journey. Expect an explosive, bass-heavy blend of underground Desi music, industrial techno, hard-hitting Bhangra anthems, and cinematic Bollywood festival edits that will keep the room vibrating until the lights come up. Accompanied by Club 624's state-of-the-art sound system, immersive laser arrays, and custom visual projections, this is a full-sensory rave experience designed for the true night owls.

🧵 The Vision & Vibe
The Dress Code: Ugly Holiday Sweaters are highly encouraged, but not mandatory. 
Whether you want to pull up in neon knits, flashing LEDs, and glowing bindi accents, or just show up in your favorite rave wear, all fits are welcome. Just make sure you wear something you can move in, because the room will be hot.The Sonic Profile: Heavy curation of global Desi music, Punjabi bass, hypnotic techno, tech-house grooves, and high-tempo Bollywood festival remixes.The Environment: Think strobe lights hitting tinsel, fog machines masking the bass drops, festival-grade production, and an unmatched community vibe where everyone is there to sweat and dance.🗓️ Event Logistics & Details
